title: I Took the Rec-Center Locker Pin to the Desk That Issued Two to Friends

parts.text: I asked for pin 22 at 5:14 p.m. and the desk had already issued 22 and 23 to friends without cards. The board said: ONE PIN. ONE CARD. NO FRIEND DOUBLES. I was thirty-three, member, holding a rec card. I photographed the board, the card, and the two issued slips. Front-of-house pinged why the desk's name was on a double. The friends returned 23. I keep 22. The wall finally looks like a board, not a favor. If it is written, it can be applied to the person who wrote it.
